cetokhilasutta:
[Cetokhila+sutta] (na) CL=10 The discourse called cetokhilasutta, The Buddha was residing at the Jetavana monastery in Sāvatthī city and he preached the monks the following in this discourse. There are five cetokhila dhammas that makes the mind stiff-violent and are similar to a stump-stake of the mind, namely, doubt in the Buddha, doubt in the Dhamma, doubt in the Saṃgha, doubt in the practice, and anger in the fellow monks. There are five cetovinibandha dhammas which ties the mind, namely, desire in the kāmaguṇa, desire in oneself, desire in the outer materials, enjoying various pleasures after eating a lot so that the stomach fills and sleeping, and practicing noble practices such as sīla wishing the wealth and happiness in the divine realm. 
There is no reason for the monk who does not abandon these five cetokhilas and five cetovinibandhas, to develop and grow in the teaching of the Buddha. Only the monk who can abandon these ten, can develop and grow in the Buddha"s teaching.

cetovimutti: [Ceta+vimutta] (ti) CL=10 One who has the (arahattaphala) concentration which is free (from the defilements). Cetovimutti (f.) [ceta + vimutta. The result of the Samatha is called cetovimutti, the result of vipassanā is called paññāvimutti. Netti. 37. ma, ṭṭha, 1. 169. Itivut, ṭṭha. 241. Sārattha, 3. 477. Four Brahmavihāras, four paths, four fruitions, these twelve realities are called appamāṇacetovimutti, ākiñcaññāyatana jhāna, four paths, four fruitions, these nine realities are called ākiñcaññacetovimutti. Vipassanā, four arūpa jhānas, four paths, four fruitions, these thirteen realities are called animittacetovimutti. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 253-4. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 136-7.] (1) Liberation of the mind, liberated mind. (a) Arahatta fruit-consciousness. (b) Anāgāmi fruit-consciousness. (c) rūpa and arūpa consciousness (8 samāpatti). (d) Fourth jhāna consciousness. (e) Akiñcaññāyatana consciousness. (f) The mind that wants to be liberated from sensual pleasure, the idea of living in the forest. (2) Liberation of concentration, liberated concentration, the concentration that is the instrument for the mind to be liberated. (a) Arahatta fruit-concentration. (b) Anāgāmi fruit-concentration. (c) path concentration (d) fruit concentration. (e) Path and fruit concentration. (f) Fruit realities apart from the wisdom in the arahatta fruit-consciousness. (3) The wisdom that is the instrument (support) for the mind to be liberated, vipassanā wisdom. (4) The reality that is the instrument (support) for the mind to be liberated. (a) Mettā that has reached the appanā stage. (b) Karuṇā that has reached the appanā stage. (c) Muditā that has reached the appanā stage. (d) Upekkhā that has reached the appanā stage. (ti) (5) One who has an instrument (support) for the concentration to be liberated, One who has liberated concentration.

cetāpanavatthu: [Cetāpana+vatthu] (na) CL=10 The strength called causing to exchange-purchase.
cetāpanna: [Citī+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=10 Cost (gold, silver, etc. that are the tools of exchanging-purchase)
cetāpehi: [Citī+ṇāpe+hi] (kā,kri) CL=10 Let know. Let exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a)
cetāpema: [Citī+ṇāpe+ma] (kā,kri) CL=10 Make know. Exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a)
cetāpemi: [Citī+ṇāpe+mi] (kā,kri) CL=10 (I) cause to know. (I) exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a)
cetāpenta: [Citī+ṇāpe+anta] (ti) CL=10 In f. cetāpentī] One who causes to know. (a) One who exchanges-Purchases. (b) One who causes to exchange-purchase (c) One who requests.
cetāpenti: [Citī+ṇāpe+anti] (kā,kri) CL=10 Cause to know. (a) exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a). (b) Cause to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b).
cetāpentī: [Cetāpenta+ī] (thī) CL=10 The nun who causes to know. (a) The nun who causes to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpenta-(b). (b) The nun who requests. See - cetāpenta-(c).
cetāpesi: [Citī+ṇāpe+ī] (kā,kri) CL=10 Caused to know, Caused to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b).
cetāpessanti: [Citī+ṇāpe+ssanti] (kā,kri) CL=10 Will cause to know, Will cause to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b).
cetāpessati: [Citī+ṇāpe+ssati] (kā,kri) CL=10 Will cause to know. (a) will exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a). Will cause to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b).
cetāpessāmi: [Citī+ṇāpe+ssāmi] (kā,kri) CL=10 (I) will cause to know, (I) will exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a).
cetāpesuṃ: [Citī+ṇāpe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=10 Caused to know, caused to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b).
cetāpetabba: [Citī+ṇāpe+tabba] (ti) CL=10 That which is caused to know. (a) That which is caused to exchange-purchase. (b) That which is requested.
cetāpetha: [Citī+ṇāpe+tha] (kā,kri) CL=10 Let cause to know, Let cause to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a).
cetāpeti: [Citī+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=10 Causes to know. (a) Exchanges-purchases. (b) Causes to exchange-purchase. (c) Requests.
cetāpetukāma: [Cetāpetuṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=10 One who wants to cause to know, One who wants to exchange-purchase.
cetāpetuṃ: [Citī+ṇāpe+tuṃ] (kā,kri,vi) CL=10 To cause to know. (a) To exchange-purchase. See - cetāpetukāma. (b) To cause to exchange-purchase.
cetāpetvā: [Citī+ṇāpe+tvā] (kā,kri,vi) CL=10 Having caused to know. (a) Having exchanged-purchased. (b) Having caused to exchange-purchase.
cetāpeyya: [Citī+ṇāpe+eyya] (kā,kri) CL=10 Would cause to know. (a) Would exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a). (b) Would cause to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b). (c) Would request. See - cetāpeti-(c).
[Citī+ṇāpe+eyyaṃ] (kā,kri) CL=10 Would cause to know, Would exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a).
cetāpeyyaṃ: [Citī+ṇāpe+eyyaṃ] (kā,kri) CL=10 Would cause to know, Would exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(a).
cetāpita: [Citī+ṇāpe+ta] (ti) CL=10 That which is caused to know. (a) That which is exchanged-purchased. (b) That which is caused to exchange-purchase. (c) That which is requested.
cetāpitaarūpiya: [Cetāpita+arūpiya] (na) CL=10 Exchanged - purchased thing that is not gold or silver.
cetāpitakāla: [Cetāpita+kāla] (pu) CL=10 The time when (someone is) caused to exchange - purchase.
cetāpiyarūpiyaggahaṇa: [Cetāpita+rūpiya+gahaṇa] (na) CL=10 Receiving gold or silver that is exchanged - purchased.
ceḷa: [Cila+ṇa] (pu) CL=10 l is substituted by ḷ] (1) One who is named Ceḷa. (nt.) (2) Clothing, garment.
ceḷanāmaka: [Cela+nāma+ka] (ti) CL=10 ka - has no meaning] One with the name Ceḷa.
ceṭa: [Ciṭa+ṇa] (pu) CL=10 See - Dhāna, ṭī. 514.] (1) One who is young. Child (2) One who is commanded, Slave, Servant. See - ceṭaka.
ceṭaka: [Ciṭa+ṇvu] (pu) CL=10 In f. ceṭikā. Vi, pi, dhāna. 2. 382. Ciṭa pesane. Ceṭati. Ceṭako. Nīti, dhā. 53. Ceṭa+ṇvu. Ceṭa ceṭāyaṃ. Ceṭati. Ceṭako. Nīti, dhā. 54. Ceṭa+ka. Ciṭa pesanīye, pesīyate sāmināti ceṭo, ṇo, sake ko, ceṭako. Dhāna, ṭī. 514.] (1) One who is young, child.(2) One who is medium. (3) One who is commanded, Slave, Servant. See - ceṭaka cetaka. Tipi,7,556
ceṭakakicca: [Ceṭaka+kicca] (na) CL=10 The work-duty-responsibility of the slave.
cetasikasukhappaṭilābhasavattana: [Cetasikasukha+paṭilābha+saṃvattana] (na) CL=10 Being for the acquisition of cetasikasukha.
cetovimuttiphalānisasa: [Cetovimutti+phala+ānisaṃsa] (ti) CL=10 (1) That which has the result-profit called Arahatta fruit concentration (fruit realities apart from arahatta fruit wisdom) (arahattamaggasammādiṭṭhi). (2) (a) That which has the result-profit called path and fruit concentration (vipassanāsammādiṭṭhi). (b) That which has the result-profit called path and fruit concentration (Asubhānupassanā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā, anabhiratasaññā, aniccānupassanā, maraṇasaññā). (c) That which has the result-profit called path and fruit concentration (Aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā) See - cetovimuttiphala - (2,3)
cetāpesu: [Citī+ṇāpe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=10 Caused to know, caused to exchange-purchase. See - cetāpeti-(b).
cetāpetu: [Citī+ṇāpe+tuṃ] (kā,kri,vi) CL=10 To cause to know. (a) To exchange-purchase. See - cetāpetukāma. (b) To cause to exchange-purchase.
